About Us

Our Story

Welcome to SciHub! This platform was created by Niharika and Parimita, two passionate students who believe that science education should be accessible, engaging, and fun for everyone.

Niharika brought this vision to life by designing and developing the entire website. From the interactive games and lessons to the AI-powered tutoring features, every line of code was carefully crafted to create an intuitive and seamless learning experience. With a strong background in web development and a genuine love for science, Niharika spent countless hours ensuring that each feature would truly help students learn and grow.

Parimita played an equally vital role as the creative force behind the project. She contributed innovative ideas for making science concepts more relatable and engaging, helped design the curriculum structure, and provided valuable feedback throughout the development process. Her insights into what students need and want from an educational platform shaped the direction of SciHub.

Together, Niharika and Parimita worked as a team, combining their skills in technology and education to build something meaningful. Late-night brainstorming sessions, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to helping students succeed drove them to create this comprehensive learning platform. Their partnership demonstrates that when creativity meets technical expertise, amazing things can happen.

SciHub is more than just a website—it's a reflection of their dedication to making science education better for everyone. Whether you're struggling with a difficult concept or just want to explore science in a fun way, we're here to support your learning journey.

Meet Our Tutors

Our tutors are passionate about helping students understand science in a clear, friendly, and supportive way.
